definitions.explanation: A flat scoop-like tool used with a broom to collect swept-up dirt and debris.

examples.japanese: {箒|ほうき}と{塵取|ちりと}りで{掃除|そうじ}する。
examples.english: To clean with a broom and dustpan.

examples.japanese: {塵取|ちりと}りでゴミを{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I gathered the trash with a dustpan.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}の{掃除|そうじ}をするので、{箒|ほうき}と{塵取|ちりと}りを{持|も}ってきてください。
examples.english: I'm going to clean the entrance, so please bring the broom and dustpan.

notes: Almost always paired with {箒|ほうき} (broom) — the phrase {箒|ほうき}と{塵取|ちりと}り is a natural set. Often written in hiragana as ちりとり in everyday contexts. The word comes from {塵|ちり} (dust, dirt) and {取|と}る (to take/collect).
